s: puM, (AN + Gf + GaY) GftaM । iti hemacandraH । fgvedinAM sruveRa caturAjyaM sruci dattvA prajApatiM manasA DyAtvA tUzRImagnervAyavyakoRAdAraByAgreyIM yAvadavicCinnaGftaDArAdAnaM । punasraveRa caturAjyaM sruci dattvA indraM DyAtvAgnernErftakoRAdAraBya ESAnIM yAvadavicCinnaGftaDArAdAnaM । iti kAlesiH ॥ yajurvedinAntu sruveRa mantroccAraRapUrvvakapUrvvoktakrameRa GftaDArAdAnaM । iti paSupatiH ॥
v: pu॰ A + Gf--Ric--karmaRi ac । 1 Gfte । BAve ac । AhitavahneH vAyavyakoRAdAraByAgneyaM yAvat nErftImAraBya ESAnIM yAvaccAvacCinnaDArayA 2 Gftasecane । “tUzRImAGArAvAGAryyAjyaBAgO juhuyAdagnaye svAhA somAya svAhA” ASva॰ gf॰ । “tUzRIM mantravarjam uttarapaScimAyA AraBya dakziRapUrvvAm pratyavicCinnAmAjyaDArAM haret taTA dakziRapaScimAmAraBya uttaraRapUrvvAM pratyAGArayet” tadvfttiH iti fgvedinAm । yajurvedinAntu mantroccArapUrvvakaMtatsecananiti BedaH uBayavedinAmapi ADArakAle prajApatIndrayormana sA DyAnam AjyaM ca sruve caturvvAraM grAhyamiti vivekaH ।
m: आ-घार m. sprinkling clarified butter upon the fire at certain sacrifices, TS.; ŚBr.; KātyŚr.; ĀśvGṛ.
a: आघारः — 1 Sprinkling(in general). --2 Especially, sprinkling clarified butter upon the fire at certain sacrifices. --3 Ghee, clarified butter.

m: आ-घारण m. a partic. sacrificial ladle, L.

s: puM, (AN + han + GaY) baDasTAnaM । iti trikARqaSezaH ॥ hananaM । CedanaM । cowa kopa ityAdi BAzA ॥ (yaTA sAhityadarpaRe । “pAdAGAtAdaSokaM vikasati vakulaM yozitAmAsyamadyEH” ॥)
v: pu॰ A + hana--GaY । 1 baDe 2 Ahanane 3 tAqane ca tIvrAGAtapratihatataru svanDalagnEkadantaH” meGa॰ । “aByasyanti tawAGAtaM nirjitErAvatAgajAH” kumA॰ । “sUtrAGAtaHsa ucyate” suSrutaH । ADAre DaY । 4 baDasTAne । “AGAtaM nIyamAnasya baDyasyeva” ।
m: आ-घात m. (आ-√ हन्) ifc. ‘a striker, beater’ (see आडम्बराघ्˚ and दुन्दुभ्याघ्˚)
a stroke, blow with or on (in comp.), MBh.
a: आघातः — See under आहन्.

आघातः — [आ-हन्-घञ्] 1 Striking, striking against; अभ्यस्यंति तटाघातं Ku. 2. 50; U. 5. 9. --2 A blow, stroke; तीव्राघातप्रतिहततरुस्कंधलग्नैकदंतः Ś. 1. 33; कठिनकुचतट˚ Amaru. 55; पवन˚; पाद˚ &c. --3 A wound. --4 Killing: प्राणाघातान्निवृत्तिः Bh. 2. 26; Y. 3. 275. --5 One who beats or strikes. --6 A misfortune, distress. --7 Retention of urine (मूत्राघात). --8 A slaughter-house; आघातं नीयमानस्य वध्यस्येव पदे पदे H. 4. 67.

m: आ-घात-काल m. a critical or dangerous time, Car.

s: klI, (AN + han + svArTe Ric + lyuw) baDasTAnaM । iti hArAvalI ॥ hananaM ॥
v: na॰ Ahanyate'tra A + hana--svArTe Ric--ADAre lyuw । 1 baDasTAne hArA॰ BAve lyuw । 2 hanane ।
a: आघातनं — 1 Striking. killing. --2 A slaughter-house.

s: puM, (AN + Gaw + GaY) sImA । iti hemacandraH ॥ apAmArgaH । iti rAjanirGaRwaH ॥
v: pu॰ A + hana--karttari saMjYAyAM GaY pf॰ ni॰ tasya waH । 1 apAmArge 2 AGAtake tri॰ । “yatrAGAwAH karkaryyaH saMvadanti” SrutiH ।
m: आ-घाट m. a musical instrument (used for accompanying a dance), cymbal or rattle, AV. iv, 37, 4
आ-घाट mfn. ifc. for आ-घात (see चार्व्-आघाट and दार्वाघ्˚), Pāṇ. iii, 2, 49 Comm.
a: आघाटः — [आ-हन् घञ् निपातः] 1 Killing, striking (sometimes used as an adj.). --2 A musical instrument. --3 A cymbal or rattle. --4 Boundary, limit. --5 N. of a plant (अपामार्ग).

m: आ-घाटि m. f. (= ˚ट above) a cymbal or rattle, RV. x, 146, 2.
a: आघाटिः — m. f. Musical instruments.

v: tri॰ A + hana--Rini pf॰ ni॰ । AGAtake “AGAwimiriva DAvayan” f॰ 1, 0, 146, 2 ।

m: आ-√ घूर्ण् -घूर्णति (perf. 3. pl. -जुघूर्णुः, Bhaṭṭ.) to fluctuate, whirl, Mṛcch.; Sāh.
a: आघूर्ण् — {c1c} A., {c6c} P. 1 To roll, stagger, whirl, toss about; आघूर्णतीवानिलैः (अंबरं) Mk. 5. 27; पवनाघूर्णितपादप Hariv., Bk. 14. 77. --2 To swim, roll (as eyes); Ku. 3. 38.

m: आ-घूर्ण mfn. fluctuating, whirling round, BhP.

a: आघूर्णनं — Rolling, tossing about, whirling round, swimming.

s: tri, (AN + GUrRa + kta) GUrRitanetrAdiH । GUrARa iti BAzA । yaTA, devImAhAtmyaM ॥ “AGUrRito vA vAtena sTitaH pote mahArRave” ॥
v: tri॰ A + GUrRa--kta । 1 calite, 2 BrAnte ca ।
m: आ-घूर्णित mfn. whirled round, fluctuating, MBh. i, 2850; Hariv.; BhP. &c.

m: आघमर्षण m. a descendant of Agha-marṣaṇa (q.v.)

v: pu॰ A + Gfza--GaY । marddane “gaRqasTalAGarzagalanmadodaka” BAGaH । BAve lyuw । AGarzaRamapyatra na॰ ।
a: आघर्षः, --र्षणं — Rubbing, friction, striking against; गंडस्थलाघर्षगलन्मदोदकद्रवद्रुमस्कंघनिलायिनोऽलयः Śi. 12. 64. --णी A brush, rubber.

m: आ-घर्षणी f. a brush, rubber, L.
आ-घर्षण n. (√ घृष्), rubbing, friction, L.
आ-√ घट्ट् Caus. -घट्टयति, to touch on (as in speaking), Kām.
a: आघट्ट् — {c10c} P. 1 To strike against, touch; आघट्टयामास गतागताभ्यां Ki. 17. 38. --2 To move.

s: puM, (AN + Gawwa + vun । tataH svArTe kaH) raktApAmArgaH । iti rAjanirGaRwaH ॥

m: आ-घट्टक m. ‘causing friction’, the plant Desmochaeta Atropurpurea, L.
a: आघट्टक — a. Moving. --कः The red Apāmārga.

m: आघट्टलिका f. a horn for blowing, L.

v: strI A + Gawwa--yuc । cAlanAyAM “raRadDirAGawwanayA naBasvataH” mAGaH ।
a: आघट्टना — 1 Moving, shaking, striking against; रणद्भिराघट्टनया नभस्वतः Śi. 1. 10. --2 Friction, contact.

m: आ-घट्टन n. friction, rubbing, contact, L.
आ-√ घृ -जिघर्ति (1. sg. -जिघर्मि) to sprinkle (with fat), RV.; VS.; to throw towards (loc.), RV. iv, 17, 14; v, 48, 3 : Caus. -घारयति, to sprinkle, TS.; ŚBr.; ĀśvGṛ.
a: आघृ — {c10c} P. or Caus. To pour down upon, sprinkle.

m: आघृणी-वसु mfn. rich with heat (N. of Agni), RV. viii, 60, 20 (voc.)

v: pu॰ Agato GfRirdIptirasya । sUryye । “ehi vAM vimuco na pAdAGfRe! saMsacAvahE” । “rAyoDArAsyAGfRe vaso!” f॰ 6, 55, 1, 3 । AGfRe! AgatadIpte! he pUzan!” BA॰ ।
m: आ-घृणि mfn. glowing with heat (N. of Pūṣan), RV.
a: आघृणि — a. [आगतो घृणिर्दीप्तिरस्य] Glowing with heat or endowed with splendour, having splendid wealth. --णिः The sun.

m: आ-घ्नान mfn. (p. Ā.) beating (as with the wings)
आ-घ्नत् mfn. (p. P.), Pāṇ. iii, 1, 108; Pat.
आ-घोष m. calling out to, invocation, Nir.
a: आघोषः — Calling out, invocation.

v: na॰ A + Guza--lyuw । sarvvatra pracAraRAyoccEHSabdakaraRe । Ric--yuc । AGozaRApyatra strI ।
a: आघोषणं --णा — A proclamation, public announcement; एवमाघोषणायां कृतायां Pt. 5.

m: आ-घोषयत् mfn. (Caus. p.) causing to sound, RV. x, 76, 6; 94, 4
आ-घोषिणी f. pl. N. of a class of demons, ŚāṅkhGṛ., Sch.
आ-घोषित mfn. proclaimed aloud, MBh. iii, 647.

आ-√ घ्रा -जिघ्रति (p. -जिघ्रत्; ind.p. -घ्राय; Impv. 2. sg. -जिघ्र; impf. Ā. आजिघ्रत, MBh.; perf. 3. pl. -जघ्रुः, Bhaṭṭ.) to smell anything (acc.), AitUp.; ĀśvGṛ.; Mn. &c.; to smell at (acc.), VS.; MBh. &c.; to kiss, kiss on (loc.), MBh.; R. &c.: Caus. -घ्रापयति, to cause to smell, KātyŚr.
a: आघ्रा — {c1c} P. 1 To smell, smell at; गंधमाघ्राय Me. 21. --2 To kiss, touch (with the nose) as the head; Bk. 14. 12. --3 (Fig.) To attack, devour, seize upon; मामाघ्रातुमागतवान् Dk. 6; कामाघ्रातया अनया 116 smitten, affected; Māl. 5. 29; Bh. 3. 104.

s: klI, (AN + GrA + lyuw) tfptiH । iti hemacandraH ॥ ganDagrahaRaM । so~kA iti BAzA ॥ “BedaGrAM ganDAGrARataH .” iti kaTAsaritsAre 13 । 16 .)
v: tri॰ A + GrA--kta । 1 gfhItaganDe puzpAdO nAsikayA yasya ganDajYAnaM jAtaM tasmin 2 tfpte ca BAve kta । 3 ganGagrahaRe 4 tfptO ca na॰ ।
m: आ-घ्राण n. smelling (the scent of), Gaut.; Kathās.
a: आघ्राण — a. 1 Smelt(as flowers). --2 Satisfied. --णं 1 Smelling. --2 Satisfaction, satiety.

m: आ-घ्रात mfn. smelled at, Śak. (also अन्- neg.), Hit. &c.
आ-घ्रात n. (in astron.) one of the ten kinds of eclipses, VarBṛS.
a: आघ्रात — p. p. 1 Smelt, scented, touched. --2 Satisfied. --3 Surmounted, surpassed.

v: tri॰ A + GrA--yat । GrARena grAhye “AGreyaH sarvvadevAnAm” DUpadAnamantraH ।
m: आ-घ्रेय mfn. to be smelled at, MBh. xiv, 610.

आ-√ घुष् P. (Subj. 3. pl. -घोषान्; p. -घोषत्) to listen to (acc. or gen.), RV. ; (Subj. -घोषात्) to make one's self audible, RV. v, 37, 3; to cry aloud, proclaim, RV. (also Ā. -घोषते, i, 83, 6), VS. : Caus. -घोषयति, to proclaim aloud, Pat.; to complain continually, L.; See also आ-घोषयत्, &c.
a: आघुष् — {c1c} P. 1 To proclaim, cry aloud, declare. --2 To praise. --3 To listen. --4 To make oneself audible. --{c10c} P. or Caus. 1 To make a noise, to cause to sound. --2 To proclaim, announce publicly. --3 To complain continually, weep bitterly.
